story.text: 출발 당일 아침, 제주공항 국내선 탑승구 앞은 사람들로 붐볐다. 캐리어를 끌고 줄을 서던 나는 익숙한 뒷모습을 발견하고 걸음을 멈췄다. 196cm의 그 큰 어깨를 못 알아볼 리가 없었다.
story.reading: chul-bal dang-il a-chim, je-ju-gong-hang guk-nae-seon tap-seung-gu ap-eun sa-ram-deul-lo bum-byeot-da. kae-ri-eo-reul kkeul-go jul-eul seo-deon na-neun ig-suk-han dwit-mo-seub-eul bal-gyeon-ha-go geol-eum-eul meom-chwot-da. baek-gu-sib-yuk-sen-ti-ui geu keun eo-kkae-reul mot al-a-bol li-ga eop-seot-da.
story.en: On the morning of departure, the domestic gate at Jeju International Airport was crowded. Dragging my suitcase toward the line, I stopped short at the sight of a familiar back. There was no mistaking those broad, 196-centimeter-tall shoulders.

story.text: '어? 여기서 뭐 해요?' 놀라서 묻자 용우가 대수롭지 않게 뒤를 돌아본다. '나도 볼일 있어서 부산 간다.' 표정 하나 안 변하고 태연하게 말했다.
story.reading: eo? yeo-gi-seo mwo hae-yo? nol-la-seo mut-ja yong-u-ga dae-su-rop-ji an-ke dwi-reul dol-a-bon-da. na-do bol-il iss-eo-seo bu-san gan-da. pyo-jeong ha-na an byeon-ha-go tae-yeon-ha-ge mal-haet-da.
story.en: 'Wait, what are you doing here?' I asked, startled. Yongwoo turned back, unfazed. 'I've got things to take care of in Busan too.' He said it with a perfectly straight face.

story.text: '무슨 볼일인데요?' 캐물어도 용우는 어깨만 으쓱했다. '그냥 있다. 꼬치꼬치 캐묻지 마라.'
story.reading: mu-seun bol-il-in-de-yo? kae-mul-eo-do yong-u-neun eo-kkae-man eu-sseuk-aet-da. geu-nyang it-da. kko-chi-kko-chi kae-mut-ji ma-ra.
story.en: 'What kind of things?' I pressed, but Yongwoo only shrugged. 'Just things. Stop prying.'

story.text: 탑승권을 내밀며 게이트 직원에게 확인받던 그의 손끝, 좌석 번호가 눈에 들어왔다. 내 옆자리였다. '…설마 저랑 같은 비행기예요?' '그래서, 뭐.' 용우가 당당하게 되물었다.
story.reading: tap-seung-gwon-eul nae-mil-myeo ge-i-teu jig-won-e-ge hwak-in-bat-deon geu-ui son-kkeut, jwa-seok beon-ho-ga nun-e deul-eo-wat-da. nae yeop-ja-ri-eot-da. seol-ma jeo-rang gat-eun bi-haeng-gi-ye-yo? geu-rae-seo, mwo. yong-u-ga dang-dang-ha-ge doe-mul-eot-da.
story.en: As he handed his boarding pass to the gate staff, I caught a glimpse of the seat number on it — right next to mine. '...Don't tell me you're on the same flight as me?' 'So what if I am.' Yongwoo shot back, brazen as ever.

story.text: 누가 봐도 우연이 아니었다. 그런데도 어찌나 당당한지, 따지려던 마음이 오히려 픽 웃음으로 바뀌었다.
story.reading: nu-ga bwa-do u-yeon-i a-ni-eot-da. geu-reon-de-do eo-jji-na dang-dang-han-ji, tta-ji-ryeo-deon ma-eum-i o-hi-ryeo pik us-eum-eu-ro ba-kkwi-eot-da.
story.en: It clearly wasn't a coincidence, no matter how you looked at it. And yet he was so shameless about it that my urge to call him out melted into a small laugh instead.

story.text: '…뭘 웃어. 누가 니 혼자 보내나. 걱정돼서 그런 거니까 오해하지 마라.' 귀 끝이 살짝 붉어진 채로 시치미를 뗐다.
story.reading: mwol us-eo. nu-ga ni hon-ja bo-nae-na. geok-jeong-dwae-seo geu-reon geo-ni-kka o-hae-ha-ji ma-ra. gwi kkeut-i sal-jjak bulg-eo-jin chae-ro si-chi-mi-reul ttet-da.
story.en: '...What are you laughing at. Who's letting you go alone. I'm just worried, so don't get the wrong idea.' He played it off, the tips of his ears turning faintly red.

story.text: 탑승 안내 방송이 울리자 용우가 먼저 캐리어를 들고 앞장선다. '가면서 대화 몇 개 들어봐라. 심심할 텐데.'
story.reading: tap-seung an-nae bang-song-i ul-li-ja yong-u-ga meon-jeo kae-ri-eo-reul deul-go ap-jang-seon-da. ga-myeon-seo dae-hwa myeot gae deul-eo-bwa-ra. sim-sim-hal ten-de.
story.en: As the boarding announcement rang out, Yongwoo picked up my suitcase and walked ahead first. 'Listen to a couple of conversations on the way. You'll get bored otherwise.'

words.meaning: Something to attend to, an errand
words.example_en: I have some things to take care of in Busan.
Even after getting caught, he wore a brazen expression.
He plays innocent even though he clearly knows.

sentences.ko: 게이트 앞에서 나는 낯익은 큰 그림자를 발견하고 걸음을 멈췄다.
sentences.reading: ge-i-teu ap-e-seo na-neun nat-ig-eun keun geu-rim-ja-reul bal-gyeon-ha-go geol-eum-eul meom-chwot-da
sentences.en: At the gate, I stopped short at the sight of a familiar tall figure.

sentences.ko: 부산에 볼일이 있다는 그의 말은 누가 봐도 핑계였다.
sentences.reading: bu-san-e bol-il-i it-da-neun geu-ui mal-eun nu-ga bwa-do ping-gye-eot-da
sentences.en: His claim of having things to take care of in Busan was, to anyone's eyes, an excuse.

sentences.ko: 캐물어도 그는 시치미를 떼며 어깨만 으쓱였다.
sentences.reading: kae-mul-eo-do geu-neun si-chi-mi-reul tte-myeo eo-kkae-man eu-sseog-yeot-da
sentences.en: No matter how I pressed him, he played innocent and only shrugged.

sentences.ko: 탑승권 속 좌석 번호를 보고서야 같은 비행기라는 걸 알아챘다.
sentences.reading: tap-seung-gwon sok jwa-seok beon-ho-reul bo-go-seo-ya gat-eun bi-haeng-gi-ra-neun geol al-a-chaet-da
sentences.en: It was only from the seat number on his boarding pass that I realized we were on the same flight.

sentences.ko: 그는 당당하게 '누가 니 혼자 보내나'라고 말하며 귀를 붉혔다.
sentences.reading: geu-neun dang-dang-ha-ge nu-ga ni hon-ja bo-nae-na-ra-go mal-ha-myeo gwi-reul bulk-yeot-da
sentences.en: He declared, brazen as ever, 'Who's letting you go alone,' his ears turning red.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 잠깐만요, 이 비행기 저랑 같은 편이잖아요. 우연이에요?
turns.reading: jam-kkan-man-yo, i bi-haeng-gi jeo-rang gat-eun pyeon-i-jan-a-yo. u-yeon-i-e-yo?
turns.en: Hold on, this is the same flight as mine. Is that a coincidence?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 우연이지 그럼 뭐겠어. 세상 참 좁다, 그치.
turns.reading: u-yeon-i-ji geu-reom mwo-gess-eo. se-sang cham job-da, geu-chi.
turns.en: What else would it be but a coincidence. Small world, huh.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.en: You don't look surprised at all, though.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 원래 잘 안 놀란다, 내가. 자, 짐이나 이리 줘봐.
turns.reading: won-lae jal an nol-lan-da, nae-ga. ja, jim-i-na i-ri jwo-bwa.
turns.en: I just don't rattle easily, that's all. Here, hand me your bag.

dialogues.question: 용우가 손님과 같은 비행기를 탄 것에 대해 보인 태도로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best describes Yongwoo's attitude about ending up on the same flight as the passenger?
dialogues.correct_answer: 명백한 우연이 아닌데도 태연하게 우연인 척한다
options: 명백한 우연이 아닌데도 태연하게 우연인 척한다
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 명백히 일부러 같은 비행기를 예매했으면서도 태연하게 우연인 척 시치미를 뗐습니다.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 볼일이 뭔데요 대체? 말을 해줘야 알죠.
turns.reading: bol-il-i mwon-de-yo dae-che? mal-eul hae-jwo-ya al-jyo.
turns.en: What errand is it, seriously? You have to tell me for me to know.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …그냥, 니가 걱정돼서 그런 거다. 그거면 됐지 않냐.
turns.reading: geu-nyang, ni-ga geok-jeong-dwae-seo geu-reon geo-da. geu-geo-myeon dwaet-ji an-nya.
turns.en: ...It's just because I'm worried about you. Isn't that enough.

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 혼자 여행 좀 가겠다는데 왜 이렇게까지 해요?
turns.reading: hon-ja yeo-haeng jom ga-get-da-neun-de wae i-reo-ke-kka-ji hae-yo?
turns.en: I just wanted to take one little solo trip, why go this far?

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 됐고. 누가 니 혼자 그렇게 보내나. 내가 있는데.
turns.reading: dwaet-go. nu-ga ni hon-ja geu-reo-ke bo-nae-na. nae-ga it-neun-de.
turns.en: Never mind that. Who's letting you go alone like that. Not while I'm around.

dialogues.question: 용우가 굳이 같은 비행기를 예매하면서까지 동행한 진짜 이유는 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What is the real reason Yongwoo went so far as to book the same flight?
dialogues.correct_answer: 손님이 걱정되고, 함께 가고 싶었기 때문
options: 손님이 걱정되고, 함께 가고 싶었기 때문
비행 스케줄이 원래 그렇게 짜여 있어서
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 '볼일'이라는 핑계를 댔지만, 실제로는 손님이 걱정되고 함께 가고 싶은 마음에 같은 비행기를 예매했습니다.
